about: The Workbench icons of the Freeciv drawer: python3 AMICRADLE/scripts/port_icons.py platforms/amigaos3/icons/icons.json --out platforms/amigaos3/icons (DalsinAI/amicradle). The art is Freeciv's own client icon (data/icons/128x128/freeciv-client.png, GPL-2.0-or-later). The game's icon is the Freeciv script, started by IconX: it sets the stack and the client's options.
